answer: Proposal: weight reward and votes by bonded tokens, not by headcount. Each account locks a bond on-chain; its share of the reward meadow is exactly linear in that bond. So k keys holding S tokens total draw precisely what one key holding S draws: splitting an island into islets adds no land, and a gale of fresh registrations mints no influence without buying real tokens (assumption: fixed issuance, market price). Bonds slash on provable double-votes after a withdrawal delay. Leak: cheap stake rental, borrowed collateral.
